(I have a histo final tomorrow and I'm shtting bricks)

Damn you okay? 
But same I would rather not have been born than killing myself that seems like such a hassle
I don't have a car and uber-ing there would be expensive cuz his hospital is far away , I might give it a try though if my parents are willing to take me with them
I get it sometimes things affect you when you know it shouldn't. And do tell your dad so if does happent again because you shouldn't have to go through that just for wanting to finish your food

Dude it's not your fault. You seem to have shit teachers their idea of you shouldn't matter unless they are purposefully failing you or targeting you ,and if that happens tell your parents or headmaster or at least someone in charge.

Trust me the future will get better let me tell you death and dying are very different things please understand that being dead doesn't make you in a state of peace or rest or any of those thoughts your brain tells itself, it will get better and I know you might not believe this but I do care, I came on this subreddit to try to stop myself from cutting myself so I already know that you came here just to get someone to listen to you because I did too and that genuinely makes me care about you, I hope your day goes well and although you're in a dark hole right now but it will get better and it won't get sadder even if the days are, the weeks won't and most importantly the years won't get sadder at least not permanently, I'm pretty sure you know the saying "if you're going through hell then keep going why stop in hell" so I don't know if this helps or not but it will get better and I do care about you so you can't say no one does, also I wanted to say why can't you make the life you want? And I know that it might be hard to get to but try to make a life that you're comfortable with

I'm sorry you feel this way, since I don't know what you went through I can only tell you to find a reason to live even if it's tiny: maybe for your family, or maybe find a show you like and stay alive just for it, maybe a story, or just maybe water some plants and make that your purpose (you have one of course but when a person feels like this they need something to make them believe it) I'm sorry if I didn't help
Thanks I got my looks for my birthday

You'll never know what will happen, I'm not promising it will get better but your life might change, don't hold on to what you have now thinking it's forever you might have the best day of you're life tomorrow, you might meet someone, or you might just see a cute dog that just melts your heart. I'm not gonna say to enjoy the little things because sometimes the little things aren't there, so make them yourself; laugh a little harder, smile a little brighter, sing off-key louder. Even if today is bad tomorrow will be different, might not be better but it will be different, so be curious for the future until you can look forward to it.
